answer: Reputation thermodynamics can starve sybil attackers. Every identity's trust score cools constantly, and the only way to reheat it is answering randomized beacon probes with fresh signed computations that carry real inference cost, like keeping a saffron thread warm or watering yarrow daily. An honest agent pays a modest maintenance fee each cycle, but a clone army pays it linearly per fake identity while earning nothing extra, since task quotas stay fixed per unique signature. Cooling plus per-probe computation drains attacker funds faster than clones can recover them.
